notes: CadenceToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 CADENCE once to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. It exposes no further minting, burning, transfer fees, or privileged administrative controls. There are no application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
